name: Hanseatic Town of Visby
description: Visby sits on the Swedish island of Gotland in the Baltic Sea. In the Middle Ages it was the Hanseatic League's leading trading hub in the region. A 3.4 km stone wall still rings the old town, enclosing winding alleys, ruined churches and more than 200 merchants' warehouses and houses, making it northern Europe's best-preserved walled trading city.
